title: Hearing on the business challenges facing child care providers
summary: The Council's Committee on Small Business and Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education held an oversight hearing examining the economics and regulatory burdens facing New York City child care businesses, including rising insurance and labor costs, background check and permitting delays, and voucher administration. The hearing also considered Introduction 445, which would require the Department of Small Business Services to expand its Business Pathways program to help more residents start child care businesses. Witnesses included officials from the Mayor's Office of Child Care, the Department of Small Business Services, NYCHA, and child care providers and advocates.
